info.name: OpReady API
info.description:
REST API collection for the OpReady.

**Authentication**

Two modes are supported:

1. **API Key** (recommended for external integrations) — set the `apiKey` collection variable and all requests will include `X-API-Key` automatically.
2. **Session Cookie** — use the `POST /login` request first; the session cookie is stored automatically by Postman.

**Setup**
1. Set the `baseUrl` variable to your instance URL (default: `http://localhost:3000`).
2. Set the `apiKey` variable to a key generated in System Tools → API Key Management.

variable.description: Paste your API key here (generated in System Tools → API Key Management)

item.name: Auth
item.description: Login, MFA, logout, and session info.

request.description: Authenticates with email and password. If MFA is enabled, returns `mfaRequired: true` and you must follow up with POST /login/mfa.
Completes the MFA challenge after a login that returned `mfaRequired: true`.
Sends a password reset link to the registered email address. Always returns HTTP 200 with a uniform message regardless of whether the address exists — prevents email enumeration.
Completes a password reset using the token from the /forgot-password reset link. Token expires after 30 minutes. Returns 400 if the token is invalid or expired.
Destroys the current session and redirects to /login.html.
Returns the currently authenticated user's info and role.

request.description: Returns all members as a plain array (no pagination params).
Returns `{ items, total, limit, offset }`. Add `search=<text>` to filter by member name.
Scrapes the external OI dashboard and returns member names not yet in the database.

item.name: Forms

request.description: Downloads all form templates as a JSON file.
Upload a previously exported JSON file to restore all form templates.

item.name: Live Forms
item.description: Active form submission tracking. Requires admin role.

request.description: Update a live form's status or archive flag. Valid status values: sent, submitted, accepted, rejected, disabled. Cannot revert accepted/rejected back to sent (returns 409).
Admin accepts a submitted live form. Disabled in demo mode (403).
Admin rejects a submitted live form. Set generateNew to true to archive the current form and issue a retry link. Disabled in demo mode (403).
Superadmin only — permanently removes all live form records.

item.name: Users
item.description: Admin user account management. Requires admin role.

request.description: Creates a new admin user. A welcome email with the temporary password is sent automatically. The new user's role must not exceed the calling user's own role (e.g. an admin cannot create a superadmin account).

item.name: Profile
item.description: Current user's own profile and MFA settings.

request.description: Generates a new TOTP secret and QR code. Requires currentPassword to confirm identity before issuing MFA credentials. Scan the returned QR code with an authenticator app then call MFA Verify.
Disables MFA for the current user account. Requires a valid 6-digit TOTP code from the authenticator app to confirm the action.

item.name: API Keys
item.description: Manage API keys for external integrations. Requires admin role.

request.description: Returns all keys. The full key value is never returned — only the prefix for identification.

Creates a new API key. role must be one of: superadmin, admin, simple, guest — and cannot exceed the calling user's own role (role-elevation is blocked). The full key is returned once in the response — store it immediately.
Flips the active flag. A revoked key returns 401 on all subsequent requests.

Returns paginated call log entries for all API key requests. Supports sorting by any column (logged_at, key_name, method, endpoint, origin_ip, status_code) and filtering by keyId, method, endpoint (partial URL match including query string), and date range.

Returns all matching call log entries as a JSON download (no pagination). Accepts the same filter and sort parameters as List API Call Log. Response includes Content-Disposition header with a suggested filename.
Permanently deletes call log entries older than the specified number of days. Returns deletedCount.

item.name: System
item.description: Health check, preferences, event logs, and diagnostics.

request.description: Returns a 64-character hex CSRF token tied to the current session. Include as `X-CSRF-Token` header on all POST/PUT/DELETE requests when authenticating with session cookies. The frontend fetch interceptor in utils.js handles this automatically.
Public — no authentication required. Returns DB connectivity and server uptime.
Public — no authentication required. Returns 200 when fully ready (DB ok, WhatsApp client ready if enabled). Returns 503 while initialising. Use as a Docker/Kubernetes readiness probe.
Returns distinct categories and actors for filter dropdowns.
Downloads all matching event logs as a JSON file.
Superadmin only — deletes events older than the specified number of days.
Superadmin only — permanently deletes the entire event log.

Writes a custom entry to the event log. Requires admin role or above. Writes to restricted categories (Security, System, User Mgmt, API Keys, WhatsApp) are blocked — those categories are reserved for server-side operations only.

Superadmin only — generates a full SQL dump of the database and returns it as a downloadable `.sql` file. Safe to call from external schedulers (e.g. cron on a Raspberry Pi or a Cloud Scheduler job) using an API key to wake the Cloud Run instance and retrieve a backup. The response is streamed as `Content-Type: text/plain` with `Content-Disposition: attachment`.

formdata.description: The .sql dump file to restore from

request.description: Superadmin only — uploads a `.sql` dump file and replaces the entire database. Disabled in demo mode. All active sessions are invalidated after restore. Use with extreme caution — this is irreversible.
Superadmin only — lists immediate subdirectories of the given server path. Used by the Backup & Restore UI directory navigator.
Superadmin only — returns all configured remote backup servers.
Superadmin only — adds a new remote OpReady server (max 5).
Superadmin only — tests a connection before saving a server.
Superadmin only — updates server details. Omit apiKey to keep the stored key unchanged.
Superadmin only — tests the saved credentials for a remote server.
Superadmin only — immediately pulls a backup from the remote server.
Superadmin only — saves the automated pull schedule for a remote server. backupLocation sets the local path where pulled files are saved (defaults to /app/backups/remote/<server-name> if blank).
Superadmin only — returns pull history entries for a remote server.
Superadmin only — clears all pull history entries for a remote server.
Superadmin only — deletes a remote server and its history. Pulled backup files are not deleted.
Superadmin only — returns the current scheduled backup configuration and the last 20 run history entries.
Superadmin only — saves scheduled backup configuration and restarts the scheduler. Disabled in demo mode and on ephemeral deployments.
Superadmin only — triggers the scheduled backup immediately. Disabled in demo mode.
Superadmin only — deletes all scheduled backup history log entries.
